query_reviews.note: 中英文同义；连续产量与整批、0-1开线决策共同要求 MIP，QP 缺少二次结构依据。
The pair is semantically aligned; continuous quantities plus batch and binary opening decisions require MIP, while no quadratic structure supports QP.
中英文同义；最少站点覆盖需求点对应 covering model，二元 IP 是完整表述，MST 的连接目标不同。
The pair is aligned; minimum site coverage is a covering model with a valid binary IP formulation, whereas MST optimizes connectivity.
中英文同义；最短闭合全顶点巡回对应 TSP，Hamiltonian cycle 是其可行结构，普通最短路不满足全点恰访一次。
The pair is aligned; the minimum closed all-vertex tour is TSP, with Hamiltonian cycle as its feasible structure, unlike a single shortest path.
中英文同义；允许非终端中继点并最小化连线总长精确对应 Steiner tree，matching 不能构造连通网络。
The pair is aligned; optional nonterminal relays with minimum total connection length define a Steiner tree, while matching does not ensure connectivity.
中英文同义；容量、单位费用、供需和平衡约束对应最小费用网络流，LP 是完整线性表述，matching 不输送连续流量。
The pair is aligned; capacities, costs, supply-demand balance and conservation define min-cost flow, with LP as a complete formulation and matching as a valid negative.
中英文同义；随机到达、随机服务、等待和拥堵均直接对应排队论，库存理论没有补货状态。
The pair is aligned; random arrivals and services with waiting and congestion directly require queueing theory, not inventory replenishment.
中英文同义；不确定需求与提前期下的多期订货是库存问题，库存水平和时期支持 DP，排队论对象不符。
The pair is aligned; multi-period ordering under uncertain demand and lead time is inventory control with a valid DP state recursion, not queueing.
中英文同义；动作改变随机状态转移和长期收益精确对应 MDP，DP 是 Bellman 求解结构，确定性差分递推不足。
The pair is aligned; action-dependent stochastic transitions and long-run reward define an MDP, with DP as its Bellman solution structure.
中英文同义；多个不可固定加权合并的冲突目标对应多目标规划，TOPSIS 只排序既定方案而不优化配置变量。
The pair is aligned; conflicting objectives that cannot be collapsed into fixed weights require multi-objective programming, while TOPSIS only ranks fixed alternatives.
中英文同义；领导者先决策、跟随者响应且目标不同构成多层规划，AHP 的准则层次不能表达战略响应。
The pair is aligned; sequential leader-follower optimization with distinct objectives is multi-level programming, not an AHP criteria hierarchy.
中英文同义；光滑目标含等式和不等式约束时的局部必要条件对应 KKT，Newton 类方法是求解器而非所求条件。
The pair is aligned; KKT gives the requested necessary conditions for smooth equality and inequality constraints, whereas Newton methods are solvers.
中英文同义；用松弛界和可行界剪枝并证明全局最优精确对应 branch-and-bound，relaxation 是明确组成，GA 不证明最优。
The pair is aligned; pruning by relaxation and feasible bounds for a provable optimum defines branch-and-bound, with relaxation as an explicit component and GA as a valid negative.
中英文同义；近期动作记忆和防循环对应 tabu search，SA 是作业车间中合理的概率越障替代，greedy 不具备记忆或越障。
The pair is aligned; recent-move memory and cycle avoidance identify tabu search, SA is a valid probabilistic escape alternative, and greedy lacks both mechanisms.
中英文同义；连续黑箱、无梯度、群体并行和历史最优共享支持 PSO，GA 是合理群体替代，CG 依赖结构化可微问题。
The pair is aligned; derivative-free population search sharing historical bests supports PSO, GA is a valid population alternative, and CG requires unsuitable structure.
中英文同义；非线性交互和缩放不敏感的表格分类支持随机森林，boosting 是合理集成替代，朴素贝叶斯独立假设受冲突特征破坏。
The pair is aligned; scale-insensitive nonlinear tabular classification supports random forest, boosting is a valid ensemble alternative, and Naive Bayes conflicts with interacting features.
中英文同义；少数关键边界样本与最大分隔支持 SVM；近似高斯且共享协方差可稳定估计使 LDA 成为合理替代，Naive Bayes 条件不足。
The pair is aligned; a widest separation determined by critical boundary samples supports SVM, while the explicit Gaussian shared-covariance condition makes LDA acceptable.
中英文同义；已知簇数、近球形和可扩展中心支持 K-means，EM 提供合理软分配，完整层次树在该规模下不合适。
The pair is aligned; known-k spherical groups and scalable centroids support K-means, EM supplies a valid soft assignment, and a full hierarchy is unsuitable at this scale.
中英文同义；二维拓扑保持映射对应 SOM，粗到细嵌套群体明确支持层次聚类，K-means 不保留两类结构。
The pair is aligned; topology-preserving 2D mapping identifies SOM and nested coarse-to-fine groups support hierarchical clustering, unlike flat K-means.
中英文同义；共线性下稳定线性系数对应 ridge，查询明确要求普通线性基线，Poisson 回归不适用于一般连续响应。
The pair is aligned; ridge stabilizes coefficients under collinearity, ordinary linear regression is explicitly requested as a baseline, and Poisson targets counts.
中英文同义；无适合全局形式且需按邻近样本拟合局部趋势精确对应 LWLR，ridge 的全局收缩不能产生局部适应。
The pair is aligned; nearby-sample local fits without a suitable global form identify LWLR, while global ridge shrinkage cannot provide local adaptation.
中英文同义；两组变量线性组合的最大共同变化精确对应 CCA；PCA 只优化组内方差，LLE 又缺少流形前提，均为合理 hard negatives。
The pair is aligned; maximum shared variation between linear combinations of two views defines CCA; PCA is within-view and LLE lacks a manifold premise, making both valid negatives.
中英文同义；保持局部重构权重对应 LLE，图拉普拉斯谱映射是合理替代，PCA 不能展开弯曲流形。
The pair is aligned; preservation of local reconstruction weights identifies LLE, Laplacian Eigenmaps is a valid graph alternative, and PCA is an appropriate linear negative.
中英文同义；bootstrap 并行训练并平均精确对应 bagging，随机特征选择对应随机森林，boosting 的顺序纠错目标不同。
The pair is aligned; parallel bootstrap averaging defines bagging, feature randomization supports random forest, and boosting is sequential rather than the requested variance reduction.
中英文同义；非平稳趋势、差分和自相关支持 ARIMA，离散递推明确支持 difference equation，充足长序列不适合 grey forecasting。
The pair is aligned; nonstationary trend, differencing and autocorrelation support ARIMA, recurrence supports difference equations, and abundant data makes grey forecasting a valid negative.
中英文同义；金融收益率的波动聚集和时变条件方差精确对应 GARCH，grey forecasting 不表示该方差动态。
The pair is aligned; volatility clustering and time-varying conditional variance in returns identify GARCH, while grey forecasting does not model this variance process.
中英文同义；分舱传播、传播参数和干预比较对应传染病模型，人口预测没有感染转移机制。
The pair is aligned; compartmental transmission, parameter estimation and intervention comparison require an infectious-disease model, not demographic projection.
中英文同义；河流平流扩散、排放源和衰减对应污染输运模型，有限差分递推是合理伴随方法，纯热传导缺少流动与源项。
The pair is aligned; river advection-diffusion with sources and decay identifies the pollutant model, finite-difference recurrence is a valid companion, and heat conduction lacks flow and sources.
中英文同义；专家两两比较和一致性检验对应 AHP，正负理想解排序对应 TOPSIS，客观熵权与专家权重要求相反。
The pair is aligned; pairwise expert judgments with consistency identify AHP and positive-negative ideal ranking identifies TOPSIS, while entropy weighting is objective.
中英文同义；指标离散程度客观赋权对应 entropy-weighting，理想解距离排序对应 TOPSIS，AHP 与禁止专家赋权冲突。
The pair is aligned; dispersion-based objective weights identify entropy weighting and ideal-distance ranking identifies TOPSIS, while AHP contradicts the no-expert condition.
中英文同义；模糊语言等级和隶属度综合对应模糊综合评价，AHP 可按查询作为专家权重输入，DEA 不处理模糊隶属。
The pair is aligned; fuzzy linguistic levels and membership aggregation identify fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, with AHP as an explicit weighting input and DEA as a valid negative.
中英文同义；准则依赖、反馈和网络优先权精确对应 ANP，AHP 是明确要求的独立层次比较，TOPSIS 不计算反馈权重。
The pair is aligned; dependencies, feedback and network priorities identify ANP, AHP is the requested independence comparison, and TOPSIS does not infer feedback weights.
中英文同义；多投入多产出的相对效率前沿及非前沿低效程度精确对应 DEA，ANOVA 只比较均值。
The pair is aligned; a multi-input, multi-output relative efficiency frontier and inefficiency distances define DEA, whereas ANOVA compares means.
中英文同义；近似正态连续变量的线性相关检验对应 Pearson，预测直线明确支持 linear regression，Kendall concordance 面向多排序者一致性。
The pair is aligned; Pearson tests linear association for the stated continuous data, linear regression supplies the requested predictive line, and Kendall concordance targets rater rankings.
中英文同义；连续且近似对称的非正态配对差值满足 signed-rank 条件，参数预先给定的正态参考分布支持单样本 KS，ANOVA 忽略配对。
The pair is aligned; continuous approximately symmetric non-normal paired differences support signed ranks, the fully specified normal reference supports one-sample KS, and ANOVA ignores pairing.
中英文同义；四组均值比较对应 ANOVA，残差与参考连续 CDF 的吻合检查支持 KS，signed-rank 的配对结构不存在。
The pair is aligned; four-group mean comparison requires ANOVA, residual agreement with a reference continuous CDF supports KS, and no paired design supports signed ranks.
中英文同义；分类计数与规定比例对应卡方拟合优度，连续样本与给定分布对应 KS，ANOVA 与两项任务均不符。
The pair is aligned; categorical counts against specified proportions require chi-square GOF and a continuous sample against a given distribution supports KS, not ANOVA.
中英文同义；年龄分组的出生、死亡和迁移递推对应人口预测模型，difference equation 是明确结构，传染病模型缺少感染机制。
The pair is aligned; cohort updates by births, deaths and migration define population projection, with difference equations as the explicit recurrence and infectious disease as a valid negative.
中英文同义；资本、劳动、技术和储蓄率驱动的长期产出对应经济增长模型，年度状态递推支持 difference equation，人口预测不含资本机制。
The pair is aligned; capital, labor, technology and saving-rate scenarios define an economic growth model, with annual difference equations and demographic projection as a valid negative.
中英文同义；时变边界下的内部温度场对应瞬态热传导，时空有限差分支持 difference equation，河流污染模型需要不存在的平流和源项。

The pair is aligned; transient internal temperature under changing boundaries defines heat conduction, finite-difference recurrences are valid, and river pollution requires absent advection and sources.
中英文同义；双方兵力消耗对应 battle model，确定性分阶段动作和状态转移支持动态规划，传染病分舱不表达对抗策略。
The pair is aligned; opposing-force attrition defines a battle model, deterministic staged actions support dynamic programming, and infectious compartments do not represent strategic opposition.

equivalence_reviews.note: method-0 与 method-38 均定义线性目标和线性约束下的同一线性规划方法，合并不会掩盖不同建模概念。
method-89 与 method-90 的标准化、熵值、差异系数和客观权重步骤实质相同，应作为一个 Recall 概念。
